killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) accounts for every font file under src/game/fonts, so a new face cannot ship without its notice
vendored third-party source (issue #771) stores each typeface's SIL Open Font License whole, under that face's own copyright line
vendored third-party source (issue #771) names every vendored file in CONTENT-LICENSE.md, which would otherwise class it as first-party code
why: Drops a whole typeface, the last one declared, from VENDORED_SOURCES: Inter ships in dist/ behind a developer arm and its notice disappears from THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and the Legal page. The inventory names the undeclared file, the OFL test's list of faces comes up short, and the CONTENT-LICENSE.md control no longer finds six font files. Scoped to vendored.test.ts alone: generate.test.ts's regenerate-and-diff would also fail, but only until `npm run notices` is run, after which the declaration and the committed notices agree on the mistake.
